title: review follow-ups of PR #36207
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5miLqNucRZevceHwNh

Filing gate ① (L1/L2 follow-ups of one PR) · Source: fleet · residuals of PR #36207 (validator half of #36167), named by L1-a's record 7072044449 (R2).

## Items
- [ ] `registerFlow`'s advisory schema pass (`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`, the `validateExpression('predicate', raw, schemaHint)` call under `advisory && useSchemaHint`) passes the validator no `flowVariables`. A declared flow variable that shares a trigger-object field's name is therefore judged as that field: after #36207 a list field's name draws a logged `list-equality` advisory, and today any field's name can draw a logged `type-mismatch` advisory, for a condition that reads the variable correctly. Logged, never thrown: the flow still registers and runs. Done when: the advisory pass hands the flow's declared variables to the validator the way `os validate` and the MCP `flow_condition` site do (#29959 / #33176 shadowing), with a pin of a variable named like a list field and a scalar field drawing no advisory, and a control with no such variable.

reach: logged advisory on flow registration, read from code (mechanism named above), not measured. Real producer: any flow whose declared variable shares a field name of its trigger object.
Business reason: an operator reading the registration log sees a refusal-shaped advisory for a correct condition and may "fix" it into a wrong one.
Reader: a domain:server lane (service-automation flow registration).
Dedupe: `registerFlow advisory flowVariables` → 1 hit (#36167, open, the parent card); `registerFlow type-mismatch advisory variable` → 4 hits, none open on this mechanism.
Grade: p3 · area:workflow · Bug · logged advisory only, no wrong behaviour · reach read · evidence read.
